summary.en: Ran was approached by Junta Misato, who somehow convinced her to have a hairdress at his workplace. Ran also texts Shinichi about the hairstyle she should change into. Coincidentally, when Misato pointed her to the building he worked at, both of them saw someone/something collapsing inside the third floor of the said building.

locations: System Development Company "Butterfee" office, third floor of a building
suspects: Junta Misato, Kazuhiko Chozuka, and Nako Muto
